attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "DefaultPermissionService's permission dictionary now uses OrdinalIgnoreCase keys instead of ordinal, so third-party/downstream modules with differently-cased duplicate permission names (previously distinct) could now collide or throw a duplicate-key exception during startup, breaking authorization or app boot for tenants relying on those modules."}

reason: DefaultPermissionService's permission dictionary now uses OrdinalIgnoreCase keys instead of ordinal, so third-party/downstream modules with differently-cased duplicate permission names (previously distinct) could now collide or throw a duplicate-key exception during startup, breaking authorization or app boot for tenants relying on those modules.
